Admin routes of the product types module. Every route needs a staff session and the permission named on it; send `X-Resolve-Locale: false` to receive every locale of a translatable field for editing.

## GET /v1/admin/product-types

List all product types

Parameters:

- `page` in query (string, required).
- `pageSize` in query (string, required).

Responses:

- `200`: Product types retrieved.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.

## POST /v1/admin/product-types

Create new product type

Request body: [CreateProductTypeAdminDto](#createproducttypeadmindto).

Responses:

- `201`: Product type created.
- `400`: Invalid input.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.

## DELETE /v1/admin/product-types/{id}

Delete product type

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Responses:

- `204`: Product type deleted.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.
- `404`: Product type not found.
- `409`: Product type in use.

## PATCH /v1/admin/product-types/{id}

Update product type

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Request body: [UpdateProductTypeAdminDto](#updateproducttypeadmindto).

Responses:

- `200`: Product type updated.
- `400`: Invalid input.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.
- `404`: Product type not found.

## Schemas

### CreateProductTypeAdminDto

- `name` ([TranslatableDto](#translatabledto), required).
- `code` (string, pattern `/^[a-z0-9]+(?:[_-][a-z0-9]+)*$/`, required).
- `taxClassId` (string, optional).

### TranslatableDto

- `fr` (string, optional).
- `en` (string, optional).
- `ar` (string, optional).
- `default` (string, required).
